desc: The Bushnell A3 offers the best of both worlds — compact enough to travel easily, yet powerful enough to capture every detail. Fully multi-coated lenses provide bright, crisp images, while the organic wave-texture armor gives a confident grip and modern look inspired by nature. With Waterproof (IPX7 rated) protection, EXO Barrier lens coatings, and the Snap-Lock strap system, A3 is ready for anything from road trips to ridge lines — backed by the Bushnell Lifetime Warranty.
